# eKathimerini.com

> > Greece's leading daily newspaper delivering comprehensive coverage of politics, economy, and international affairs with in-depth analysis and exclusive interviews.

eKathimerini.com is Greece's premier English-language news source, offering breaking news, political analysis, economic reporting, and cultural content focused on Greek and Mediterranean affairs. The site serves as a primary resource for understanding Greek politics, EU relations, and regional geopolitical developments.

## Key Topics

- Greek Politics
- Greece-Turkey Relations
- Greek Economy
- Energy Crisis
- Kyriakos Mitsotakis
- Foreign Policy
- Stock Market (ATHEX)
- Athens
- EU Affairs
- Mediterranean Affairs
- Artificial Intelligence
- Infrastructure
- Corruption & Crime
- Opinion & Analysis
- Daily News Roundup

## Core News & Politics

- [Homepage](https://www.ekathimerini.com): eKathimerini.com homepage: Greece's leading daily political and economic newspaper
- [News](https://www.ekathimerini.com/news): Main news section covering Greek politics, society, economy and breaking news
- [Politics](https://www.ekathimerini.com/politics): Greek politics coverage including Greece-Turkey relations and foreign affairs
- [Opinion](https://www.ekathimerini.com/opinion): Opinion columns and editorial commentary on Greek politics and foreign policy

## Economy & Business

- [Economy](https://www.ekathimerini.com/economy): Greek economy news covering ATHEX stock market, energy and business
- [Energy](https://www.ekathimerini.com/economy/energy): Energy sector news covering fuel crisis, prices and EU policy in Greece
- [Real Estate](https://www.ekathimerini.com/economy/real-estate): Athens real estate market coverage including housing and rental trends

## In-Depth & Analysis

- [In Depth](https://www.ekathimerini.com/in-depth): In-depth journalism section with analysis, interviews and special reports
- [Analysis](https://www.ekathimerini.com/in-depth/analysis): In-depth analysis of geopolitics, energy crisis, tourism and European economics
- [Interviews](https://www.ekathimerini.com/in-depth/interviews-in-depth): Exclusive interviews with political and business leaders on Greek and global affairs

## International & Regional Affairs

- [Foreign Affairs](https://www.ekathimerini.com/politics/foreign-policy): Greek foreign policy analysis covering Aegean disputes and Mediterranean affairs
- [Diaspora](https://www.ekathimerini.com/politics/diaspora-politics): Coverage of Greek diaspora communities and Greek-related international news

## Society & Environment

- [Society](https://www.ekathimerini.com/in-depth/society-in-depth): In-depth coverage of Greek society, education, LGBTQ rights and ethics
- [Environment](https://www.ekathimerini.com/news/environment): Environmental news from Greece covering natural disasters and water crisis

## Culture & Lifestyle

- [Culture](https://www.ekathimerini.com/culture): Greek culture, art, archaeology and heritage including museum collections
- [What's On](https://www.ekathimerini.com/culture/whats-on): Events calendar and entertainment guide for Athens cultural activities
- [Lifestyle](https://www.ekathimerini.com/leisure): Travel, food, gastronomy and lifestyle content covering Greek destinations

## Optional

- [Sports](https://www.ekathimerini.com/sports): Greek sports news covering football, Olympiakos, AEK and Panathinaikos
